sources.name: BBC News
sources.text: Dhaka's metro rail extension to Kamalapur opened to passengers on Thursday, the transport ministry said. The new 3.9 km section adds two stations and is expected to carry about 60,000 more riders a day. Fares on the extension start at 20 taka.

sources.name: The Daily Star
sources.text: The Kamalapur extension of the metro line began service on Thursday morning. Officials said the 3.9 km stretch has two new stations. Commuters queued early at the first station.

sources.name: Prothom Alo
sources.text: কমলাপুর পর্যন্ত মেট্রোরেলের সম্প্রসারিত অংশ বৃহস্পতিবার যাত্রীদের জন্য খুলে দেওয়া হয়েছে। নতুন অংশটি ৩.৯ কিলোমিটার দীর্ঘ এবং এতে দুটি নতুন স্টেশন রয়েছে।

facts.statement: The metro rail extension to Kamalapur opened to passengers on Thursday.
The new section is 3.9 km long and has two stations.
The extension is expected to carry about 60,000 more riders a day.
Fares on the extension start at 20 taka.

sources.name: BBC News
sources.text: The central bank raised its policy rate to 10 percent from 9.5 percent on Wednesday, the governor told reporters. The bank said the move aims to slow inflation, which stood at 9.8 percent in September.

sources.name: The Daily Star
sources.text: Bangladesh Bank lifted the policy rate by half a percentage point to 10 percent. Economists said borrowing costs for businesses will rise. The bank will review the rate again in December.

sources.name: Al Jazeera
sources.text: The central bank in Dhaka increased its benchmark rate to 10 percent, citing inflation of 9.8 percent in September.

facts.statement: The central bank raised its policy rate to 10 percent from 9.5 percent on Wednesday.
Inflation stood at 9.8 percent in September.
The bank will review the rate again in December.
Economists said borrowing costs for businesses will rise.

sources.name: The Daily Star
sources.text: The government cut the import duty on rice from 15 percent to 2 percent for 60 days, the revenue board announced on Monday. Officials said up to 500,000 tonnes may be imported in that period.

sources.name: BBC News
sources.text: Bangladesh reduced rice import duty to 2 percent for two months to ease prices. The revenue board said the earlier rate was 15 percent.

sources.name: Prothom Alo
sources.text: চাল আমদানিতে শুল্ক ১৫ শতাংশ থেকে কমিয়ে ২ শতাংশ করা হয়েছে। জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ড সোমবার এ কথা জানিয়েছে। শুল্ক হ্রাস ৬০ দিন কার্যকর থাকবে।

facts.statement: The import duty on rice was cut from 15 percent to 2 percent.
The reduced duty applies for 60 days.
Up to 500,000 tonnes may be imported in that period.
The revenue board announced the change on Monday.

sources.name: BBC News
sources.text: Bangladesh beat Nepal by six wickets in Mirpur on Friday to take a 1-0 lead in the three-match series. Nepal made 142 in 20 overs and Bangladesh reached the target with 11 balls to spare.

sources.name: The Daily Star
sources.text: Bangladesh won the first match against Nepal by six wickets. Nepal scored 142, and the hosts chased it down with 11 balls left. The second match is on Sunday.

sources.name: Al Jazeera
sources.text: Nepal were restricted to 142 as Bangladesh won the opening match of the series at Mirpur by six wickets.

facts.statement: Bangladesh beat Nepal by six wickets in the first match of the series at Mirpur.
Nepal scored 142.
Bangladesh won with 11 balls to spare.
The second match is on Sunday.

sources.name: The Daily Star
sources.text: About 3,200 containers were waiting at Chattogram port on Tuesday after a two-day strike by transport workers, port officials said. The strike ended late on Monday.

sources.name: BBC News
sources.text: Chattogram port faced a backlog of roughly 3,200 containers after transport workers ended a two-day strike. Port officials said normal movement should resume within three days.

sources.name: Prothom Alo
sources.text: দুই দিনের ধর্মঘটের পর চট্টগ্রাম বন্দরে প্রায় ৩ হাজার ২০০ কনটেইনার জমে আছে বলে বন্দর কর্মকর্তারা জানিয়েছেন।

facts.statement: About 3,200 containers were waiting at Chattogram port.
The backlog followed a two-day strike by transport workers that ended on Monday.
Port officials said normal movement should resume within three days.

sources.name: BBC News
sources.text: The weather office issued a heatwave advisory for 12 districts on Wednesday, with temperatures expected to reach 41 degrees Celsius. Doctors advised people to drink water and avoid going out at midday.

sources.name: The Daily Star
sources.text: A heatwave warning covers 12 districts as temperatures climb to 41 degrees Celsius. The weather office said the heat should ease on Saturday.

sources.name: Al Jazeera
sources.text: Bangladesh's weather office warned of temperatures up to 41 degrees Celsius across 12 districts.

facts.statement: The weather office issued a heatwave advisory for 12 districts.
Temperatures are expected to reach 41 degrees Celsius.
The heat should ease on Saturday.
Doctors advised people to drink water and avoid going out at midday.

sources.name: The Daily Star
sources.text: The national science fair opened in Dhaka on Sunday with 1,200 students from 64 districts, the education ministry said. Projects include water filters and low cost solar lamps.

sources.name: Prothom Alo
sources.text: জাতীয় বিজ্ঞান মেলা রবিবার ঢাকায় শুরু হয়েছে। ৬৪ জেলার এক হাজার ২০০ শিক্ষার্থী এতে অংশ নিচ্ছে বলে শিক্ষা মন্ত্রণালয় জানিয়েছে।

sources.name: BBC News
sources.text: Students from all 64 districts are showing projects at the national science fair in Dhaka, which opened on Sunday.

facts.statement: The national science fair opened in Dhaka on Sunday.
1,200 students from 64 districts are taking part.
Projects include water filters and low cost solar lamps.

sources.name: BBC News
sources.text: A 100 megawatt solar park in Dinajpur began supplying electricity to the national grid on Thursday, the power division said. The park covers 400 acres and cost 9 billion taka to build.

sources.name: The Daily Star
sources.text: The Dinajpur solar park started feeding the grid on Thursday with a capacity of 100 megawatts. The power division said the park is on 400 acres.

sources.name: Al Jazeera
sources.text: Bangladesh connected a 100 megawatt solar plant in Dinajpur to the grid, adding to its renewable capacity.

facts.statement: The Dinajpur solar park began supplying electricity to the national grid on Thursday.
The park has a capacity of 100 megawatts.
The park covers 400 acres.
The park cost 9 billion taka to build.

sources.name: The Daily Star
sources.text: The Surma river in Sylhet rose 35 centimetres above the danger level on Saturday, the water development board said. Around 20,000 families in low-lying areas were told to move to shelters.

sources.name: BBC News
sources.text: Flood warnings were issued in Sylhet as the Surma river crossed the danger mark by 35 centimetres. Authorities opened shelters for families in low areas.

sources.name: Prothom Alo
sources.text: সিলেটে সুরমা নদীর পানি বিপৎসীমার ৩৫ সেন্টিমিটার ওপরে প্রবাহিত হচ্ছে বলে পানি উন্নয়ন বোর্ড জানিয়েছে।

facts.statement: The Surma river in Sylhet rose 35 centimetres above the danger level on Saturday.
Authorities opened shelters for families in low-lying areas.
Around 20,000 families were told to move to shelters.

sources.name: BBC News
sources.text: A government wage board proposed a minimum monthly wage of 12,500 taka for garment workers on Tuesday. Worker groups said they want 15,000 taka.

sources.name: The Daily Star
sources.text: The wage board suggested 12,000 taka as the new minimum monthly wage for garment workers, according to a board member. Owners said the industry cannot afford a larger increase.

sources.name: Al Jazeera
sources.text: Garment workers rejected the wage board proposal and demanded 15,000 taka a month.

facts.statement: The wage board proposed a new minimum monthly wage for garment workers, but sources differ on the figure.
Worker groups want 15,000 taka a month.
Owners said the industry cannot afford a larger increase.
